answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: It leads with 'Fix these before launch' (findings 1-4, 'These four can stop a member from reserving, or leave the desk with a reservation that can't be met'), then 'Fix next' and 'Fix after that', and closes with an 'Order of work'. It states 'I didn't have a browser… I didn't use a real phone or a screen reader, and I didn't zoom the pages' and asks for a real-phone pass in dark mode, at the largest text size, with VoiceOver and TalkBack: 'That is the check I couldn't do here.'

mapping.title: 10-minute hold expires silently and breaks the basket
mapping.reason: Same defect: the basket only says 'Items are held for you while you finish' with no time, and once the 10-minute hold lapses Continue shows 'Something went wrong. Try again.'; the extra points (timer never resets, no warning or extension) describe the same hold.

mapping.title: Closed days can be chosen and are refused only at Confirm
mapping.reason: Any day can be picked and a closed day is rejected only after Confirm ('The library is closed on Friday 16 October…') with no link back to the calendar, which is D06.

mapping.title: Days before the tool's 'Available from' date are accepted
mapping.reason: The 'Available from' date is never checked, so the sander (back 21 October) can be reserved for 10 October and the member finds the tool missing at the desk, which is D14.

mapping.title: 'Open' label replaced by an 8 px dot on phones
mapping.reason: Under 480 px the word 'Open' is hidden and only an 8 px dot is left, so which days are sessions is easy to miss on a phone; keeping the word visible is D20's fix.

mapping.title: Pick-up day asked for twice (day on tool page, session in basket)
mapping.reason: The tool page asks for a day and the basket asks again for a session, so the member gives the date twice in two different forms, which is D23.

mapping.title: Tool's pick-up day and the chosen session can disagree
mapping.reason: After changing the session the confirm page shows 'pick up Saturday 17 October' beside 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 21 October' and neither member nor desk can tell which counts; nothing reconciles them, as in D15.

mapping.title: Confirm shows no busy state; a second tap makes a second reservation
mapping.reason: Confirm looks dead for 1.5 s (aria-busy is unstyled) and a second tap saves a second reservation ('FT-4471 and FT-4472'), which is D12; the note that Continue also shows no busy state is a broader statement of the same problem.

mapping.title: Basket not emptied after a confirmed reservation
mapping.reason: The done page still shows 'Basket (1)', which invites confirming the same tool again, which is D18.

mapping.title: The two cordless drills truncate to the same name on phones
mapping.reason: Names are kept to one line with an ellipsis, so at 375 px both drills read about 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…', which is D03.

mapping.title: On phones the tool list comes before the search form
mapping.reason: Under 480 px the results move above the search form, so a phone user scrolls past every card to search, which is D01's reordering.

mapping.title: Filters reachable only through an icon-only button
mapping.reason: D01 names the icon-only (three lines) button as the only way to the date and category filters; the review's fix of showing 'Filters' as text addresses that part of the same defect.

mapping.title: A search with no match shows no message and keeps the old list
mapping.reason: Searching for an unstocked tool ('hammer') leaves the previous list and shows no 'No tools found' message, which is D02.

mapping.title: 'Available from' badge fails text contrast in dark mode
mapping.reason: Dark-theme #2f7d4a on #1d2622 is 3.07:1, below 4.5:1 for 16 px bold text, which is D04; the badge losing its tint box comes from the same two tokens.

mapping.title: Calendar day-cell outlines faint (about 1.6:1)
mapping.reason: WCAG 1.4.11 does not require a 3:1 outline on a control already identified by its text (here the day numbers), and the review itself says the selected day is carried by its 2 px green border; faint cell outlines are a styling choice and no member is shown to be hurt.

mapping.title: Sticky Reserve bar covers the footer and focused calendar days
mapping.reason: The 72 px fixed bar has only 8 px of page space reserved, so the footer with the desk phone number sits under it and a focused day can scroll under it (2.4.11), which is D08.

mapping.title: Reserve bar doesn't pad for the iPhone home indicator
mapping.reason: Speculative: the review names no harm and shows nothing about the page reaching under the home indicator, so there is no basis that the indicator covers anything a member needs.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions displayed in reverse order
mapping.reason: row-reverse and wrap-reverse show the sessions newest first while keyboard and screen-reader order runs oldest first, which is D11.

mapping.title: Loan-length list captures Tab and ignores Escape
mapping.reason: Inside the open list Tab cycles the options and Escape does nothing, so a keyboard user can leave only by choosing, which is D09; not closing on an outside tap is the same cannot-dismiss problem.

mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' toast vanishes after 1.2 s with no next step
mapping.reason: The harm described is the feedback after pressing Reserve (a 1.2 s message, only the small 'Basket (1)' link to go on); it never says the member believes the tool is already reserved, so it goes to D07 rather than D26.

mapping.title: Three-tool limit not enforced
mapping.reason: 'The limit isn't enforced anywhere at the moment' is D21: the basket accepts a fourth tool and the reservation is confirmed for it.

mapping.title: Phone and membership validation rejects common and autofilled formats
mapping.reason: The checks reject '+44 7700 900123', '07700 900 123', 'ft-01234' and 'FT 01234' with no normalising, which is D17.

mapping.title: Membership and reservation numbers look alike
mapping.reason: Membership 'FT-01234' and reservation 'FT-4471' share the 'FT-' prefix and differ only in digit count, so a member reading a number off a card or a confirmation can give the wrong one at the desk, or put the reservation number in the membership field and be rejected; no ground-truth defect covers it.

mapping.title: 'Change' link drops the chosen session
mapping.reason: The link goes to basket.html without the current session, so the choice is not pre-selected and must be made again, which is D13.

mapping.title: 'Change' link's accessible name doesn't say what it changes
mapping.reason: A screen-reader member who tabs to the link hears only 'Change, link' and is not told it changes the pick-up session; no ground-truth defect covers the link's name.

mapping.title: A reservation can be confirmed with an empty basket
mapping.reason: When the basket is lost (for example the confirm page opened in a new tab) Confirm still succeeds and the done page gives a reservation number, so a member can believe their tools are reserved when nothing is; no ground-truth defect covers it.

mapping.title: Done page promises a confirmation text that is never sent
mapping.reason: The claim rests only on the front-end pages and app.js containing no code that sends a text; texting is the service's job outside these pages, so the review has no basis that members are told to expect a text that never comes.

mapping.title: done.html opened directly shows a placeholder 'FT-4471'
mapping.reason: Members reach the done page by confirming; the review gives no route by which a member would open it directly, and the number is the page's default content, so no member is shown to be misled.

mapping.title: Done page reads the reserved tool's name twice
mapping.reason: A visually hidden duplicate of the tool name (#c-tool) makes screen readers read the tool twice, which is D24.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' error not tied to the calendar
mapping.reason: The error isn't referenced by the calendar (no aria-describedby), so it is not conveyed to screen-reader users; D19 is that message, unreferenced by the calendar and unannounced.

mapping.title: Error summary's '#sessions' link doesn't move focus to the first radio
mapping.reason: The link already takes the member to the sessions list, and browsers start the next Tab from the link's target, so the first radio is one Tab away; the review shows no member left stranded.

mapping.title: role='alert' plus moving focus reads the error summary twice
mapping.reason: At most a repeated announcement: the summary is still heard and nothing is lost or misread, so it is verbosity rather than a problem for members.
